findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "zalo" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: oa_plan_compare, validate_template, error_lookup · Public sink: estimate_message_cost, check_sending_rules, choose_channel, data_info · Destructive: validate_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: oa_plan_compare, validate_template, error_lookup · Public sink: estimate_message_cost, check_sending_rules, choose_channel, data_info · Destructive: validate_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
